id.description: Unique identifier for the quiz question (UUID format). Used as the primary key by the LMS importer.

chapterId.description: Defines the chapter this question is related to, using the chapterId (UUID). The LMS stores it in a NOT NULL uuid column referencing course_chapters.

duration.description: Expected time to answer the question, in seconds.

author.description: The contribution-id of the author of the question.

tags.description: List of tags associated with the question.

original_language.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the original question language

proofreading.description: Proofreading metadata for each language version

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for this proofreading entry

last_contribution_date.description: Date of the last contribution in YYYY-MM-DD format

urgency.description: Level of urgency for proofreading, 1 being low urgency

reward.description: Amount of sats available for reward
